Author: MathDad
Name: Senpan Admin Companion
Description: Serves as an alternative to many of the web-interface functions, allowing staff to operate various systems from within the game.
Punchline: Allows Senpan Tea House staff to use various app services right from the game.
Changelog: When a tea room's unlock time arrives, a pop-up now stays on screen until you dismiss it, asking you to check the room and remind the occupants or extend the time - alongside the chime and the line in your chat log. Only staff who can manage tea rooms are alerted.
